title: Function-level composition of explicit raw cohomology pullbacks
statement: For the raw pullback functions of lem-sbc-higher-image-raw-pullback-composition, the function for a composite arrow is the composition of the two pullback functions in contravariant order.

source.place: Tag 09Z1, canonical comparison maps; expansion of the five-factor formula

proof.text: Transport the existing restricted-single coefficient composition identity to the shared complexes and coefficient maps. Apply congruence with type equalities; each object equation is higherDirectImageRawOverComplex_eq and each heterogeneous coefficient equation is higherDirectImageRawOverCoefficient_heq. The helpers are the original concrete constructions.

Apply function extensionality. Apply congrArg to the coefficient identity under the raw triangle pullback for the composite arrow; reverse this equality and compose it with higherDirectImageRawTrianglePullback_comp specialized to the same shared objects and coefficients. The raw-over wrapper is its concrete implicit-reducible definition and Over.comp_left identifies the composite scheme map.

proof_origin.place: P3 repairs the representation conversion using the proved equations of the concrete data, then composes coefficient congruence with the existing triangle composition theorem.
